## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
This PR adds `preview()`, which returns the first 200 characters of a file under a home directory, and `settings_file()`, which returns the path to the settings file. It also adds tests and a text file under `tests/`. The check that keeps `preview()` inside home only compares path text, so `..` segments and symlinks can still reach files outside home. This needs to be fixed before merge.

## Critical
- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — `candidate.is_relative_to(Path(home))` compares the path text without resolving it. For `relative="../../etc/passwd"`, the joined path `home/../../etc/passwd` still starts with `home`, so the check passes and `read_text()` opens `/etc/passwd`. A symlink inside home that points elsewhere also passes. Both paths need `.resolve()` before the check. — Any caller passing user-chosen relative paths can read files outside the selected home directory, which is exactly what the "outside home" guard is meant to prevent.

- `test_preview` covers an absolute path outside home, which the current check does reject.
